fields.label: Company
fields.description: Company whose monthly budget is used. Collection and discounts use its base currency.

fields.label: Customer
fields.description: Customer whose budgets and collections are planned; one active plan per company, customer and year.

fields.label: Fiscal Year
fields.description: Year of monthly planned sales. Prior-year November/December collections can flow into this year's opening months.

fields.label: Customer Category
fields.description: For analysis and filtering only; it does not change how a discount is calculated.

fields.label: Plan Currency
fields.description: Reference currency. Calculations use the company's base currency from monthly budgets.

fields.label: Collection Lag (Months)
fields.description: 0 = collect in sale month; 1 = next month; 2 = sale in January collected in March. Also carries prior-year plans into this year.

fields.label: Plan Status
fields.description: Draft can be edited; Active participates in reports; Superseded remains as history; Cancelled is excluded.

fields.label: Revision
fields.description: Version number, advanced when a revised plan is activated.

fields.label: Previous Plan
fields.description: Historical plan version replaced by this one.

fields.label: Commercial Discount Rules
fields.description: Each row is one business discount. Different rows can use percentage, fixed amount, or tiers, independently.

fields.label: Tier Thresholds
fields.description: Use the same Rule Code as the parent discount rule. Each band has lower/upper sales threshold plus percent and optional fixed bonus.

fields.label: Planning Note
fields.description: Planning only. No Sales Invoice, Payment Entry, or accounting transactions are created.
fields.default: Forecast only; all amounts are planned, not actual.
